facts.fact: The INS report on civil-registration statistics 2018-2022, published August 2023 (the dates 2018-2022 are the years its figures cover), draws on civil-registration centre records for 2018 and on health-information (DHIS2) data for 2018-2022, alongside the 2018 demographic and health survey.

facts.fact: The INS, with BUNEC and the Ministry of Public Health, published the first edition of the report on civil-registration statistics in August 2023, covering 2018-2022; many key tables are left partly or wholly empty for lack of data.
